# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We pledge to make participation in Cleanroom a harassment-free experience for
everyone, regardless of age, body size, disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics,
gender identity and expression, experience level, education, socioeconomic status,
nationality, personal appearance, race, caste, color, religion, or sexual identity
and orientation.

We pledge to act and interact in ways that contribute to an open, welcoming,
diverse, inclusive, and healthy community.

## Expected behavior

- Demonstrate empathy and kindness toward other people.
- Respect differing opinions, viewpoints, and experiences.
- Give and gracefully accept constructive feedback.
- Accept responsibility, apologize to those affected by mistakes, and learn.
- Focus on what is best for the community and its users.

Unacceptable behavior includes sexualized language or attention, trolling, insults,
harassment, publishing another person's private information, and conduct that would
reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional setting.

## Enforcement

Project maintainers may remove, edit, or reject contributions and may temporarily or
permanently ban contributors for behavior they deem inappropriate, threatening,
offensive, or harmful. Report conduct issues privately through the contact method in
[the security policy](SECURITY.md). Reports will be handled as confidentially as
practical.

## Scope and attribution

This Code applies in project spaces and when representing the project publicly. It
adapts the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct.html).
